title: Companion CI decision check context
description: Real GitHub checks on an open PR, a timeout raised by the production CI monitor on a private gateway, in-place phone refresh and a historical gate. Set CI_CONTEXT_PROOF_REPO, CI_CONTEXT_PROOF_PR, IOS_SIMULATOR and METRO_PORT. Start the owned Metro with the recipe bridge. Always run ci-context-proof.mjs stop in the caller teardown. No worker dispatch or GitHub writes.

proofTargets.claim: A pending CI decision displays frozen snapshot and current check metadata together.
Phone refresh reloads GitHub metadata without changing the gate snapshot, actions or unresolved state.
run.list omits check rows while run.get retains the frozen snapshot.
Historical snapshots with no metadata stay explicitly unrecorded while current checks load.

setup.intent: Raise a real CI timeout on an open PR through a private gateway.

relaunch.intent: Launch Companion on the private gateway profile.

app-ready.intent: The connected Companion accepts decision links.

open.intent: Open the real pending CI decision.

wait-context.intent: The decision contains its CI comparison.

current-ready.intent: Current GitHub metadata has loaded with check links.

before.intent: Record the frozen decision and cached current GitHub read.

hud-before.intent: Gate snapshot and current GitHub checks appear together.

capture-before.label: CI snapshot and current checks before refresh
capture-before.intent: Snapshot and current checks have separate labels and source ages.

refresh.intent: Refresh current checks without leaving the decision.

refresh-finished.intent: The refresh finishes and remains available in place.

after.intent: Verify a newer GitHub read and the unchanged unresolved gate.

no-refresh-error.intent: The CI comparison has loaded without an error banner.

no-missing-current.intent: The CI comparison has loaded without an error banner.

no-loading.intent: The CI comparison has loaded without an error banner.

hud-after.intent: Refresh reloads current checks and leaves the gate unresolved.

capture-after.label: Read-only refresh complete
capture-after.intent: Current metadata reflects the new read while the snapshot stays frozen.

legacy.intent: Open a historical decision without a recorded snapshot.

legacy-ready.intent: The historical gate explicitly labels its missing metadata.

legacy-current.intent: Current checks load independently of the missing snapshot.

hud-legacy.intent: Historical check metadata stays unrecorded after current checks load.

capture-legacy.label: Legacy snapshot remains unrecorded
capture-legacy.intent: The old gate keeps unknown metadata beside fresh current checks.

refresh-visible.intent: Current check refresh is reachable beside both labels.

negative-refresh.intent: The freshness assertion must reject an omitted phone refresh.

negative-detected.contains: Phone refresh must reload GitHub metadata
negative-detected.intent: The protocol proof detects the missing refresh before the real press.
